name: What should I ask for before hiring someone to paint my kitchen and trim?
description: Ask for a written scope, prep plan, materials list, and timeline. Clear details help prevent surprises on cost and finish quality.

mainEntity.name: What should I ask for before hiring someone to paint my kitchen and trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should ask for a detailed scope, a written estimate, product details, and examples of similar kitchen work before hiring. For homeowners in the Denver metro area, it also helps to confirm how the crew handles dust control, masking, drying time, and access to the kitchen during the project.
